sources.title: Amwal Al Ghad English, Egyptian banks to close on 7 January for Orthodox Christmas (5 January 2026)
sources.said: The Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) announced on Monday that all banks in the country will be closed on Wednesday, 7 January, in observance of Coptic Orthodox Christmas.

sources.title: Amwal Al Ghad English, Egypt banks to close for 25 Jan Revolution, Police Day Holiday – CBE (21 January 2026)
sources.said: all banks operating in the country will suspend work on Thursday, 29 January 2026, on the occasion of the 25 January Revolution and Police Day.

sources.title: Amwal Al Ghad English, Egypt declares 19-23 March public holiday for Eid al-Fitr (12 March 2026)
sources.said: Egypt’s government said on Wednesday that 19-23 March, 2026 will be an official paid holiday for Eid al-Fitr for employees in the public sector. A decree issued by Prime Minister Moustafa Madbouly applies to staff in ministries, government agencies, public authorities, local administration units, public sector companies, and state-owned enterprises.

sources.title: Amwal Al Ghad English, Egypt declares 13 April paid holiday for private sector for Sham El-Nessim (8 April 2026)
sources.said: Egypt’s Ministry of Labour announced that Monday, 13 April 2026, will be a paid official holiday for private sector employees under Labour Law No. 14 of 2025, in celebration of Sham El-Nessim.

sources.title: Arab Finance, Madbouly declares May 7th as Labor Day holiday (22 April 2026)
sources.said: Egypt’s Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly has issued a decree designating Thursday, May 7th, 2026, as an official paid holiday in observance of Labor Day, as per a statement . The decision applies to employees across ministries, government departments, public authorities, local administration units, public sector companies, public business sector companies, as well as the private sector. The occasion falls on Friday, May 1 st , but the government said in 2020 it would move all mid-week vacation days, except Eid Al-Fitr, Eid Al-Adha, and Coptic Christmas, to the end of the week

sources.title: Amwal Al Ghad English, Egypt declares Eid Al Adha holiday from 26 to 31 May (19 May 2026)
sources.said: Egypt’s Prime Minister Moustafa Madbouly issued a decision on Tuesday declaring an official paid Eid Al Adha holiday from Tuesday, 26 May, until Sunday, 31 May 2026.

sources.title: Amwal Al Ghad English, Egypt declares 18 June public holiday for Islamic New Year (9 June 2026)
sources.said: Egypt’s Prime Minister Moustafa Madbouly announced Thursday, 18 June 2026, as a paid public holiday for the Islamic New Year, falling on 1 Muharram 1448 AH, pending official moon sighting confirmation.

sources.title: Amwal Al Ghad English, Egypt declares 2 July public holiday for 30 June revolution anniversary (23 June 2026)
sources.said: The government moved the holiday from Tuesday, 30 June, to Thursday, 2 July, in line with its policy of shifting some public holidays to the end of the workweek.

sources.title: Amwal Al Ghad English, Egypt declares 23 July Revolution anniversary holiday for private sector (20 July 2026)
sources.said: Egypt’s Ministry of Labour announced that Thursday, 23 July 2026, will be an official paid holiday for private sector employees covered by Labour Law No. 14 of 2025 … The decision was issued under Article 129 of Labour Law No. 14 of 2025 and is in line with Ministerial Decree No. 294 of 2025, which lists the 23 July Revolution as an official paid holiday.

sources.title: Amwal Al Ghad English, Egypt moves Prophet Muhammad’s birthday holiday to 27 August (18 August 2026)
sources.said: Egypt will observe a public holiday on Thursday, 27 August, to mark the birthday of Prophet Muhammad, instead of the originally scheduled holiday on Tuesday, 25 August 25, the prime minister’s office said .

sources.title: Amwal Al Ghad English, Egypt declares October 8 official paid holiday for Armed Forces Day (30 September 2026)
sources.said: Egypt’s Prime Minister Moustafa Madbouly has declared Thursday, October 8, 2026, an official paid holiday in observance of Armed Forces Day, replacing Tuesday, October 6.
